content:
zoe-peopleops: Quick idea  small 'Warm Wellness' kit drop for hybrid teams the week before winter break. Mix of tea sachets, hand warmers, and a $25 e-gift spot-award for 15 people. Would like to pair with a 1-week peer-nomination window. Thoughts?
raj-culture: Love it  feels cozy. Can we do low-touch assembly in SF and mail a handful?
mel-hr: Policy note: <$50 gifts are usually non-taxable but I'll confirm. Also want managers to sign off on mailing addresses.
ash-eng: I can help with assembly logistics and bring tape/glue.
nora-ops: Logistics check: shipping to international addresses adds complexity. Recommend US-only physical drops, rest get e-gift.
kudos-bot: New nomination: diego-support -> "Zoe organized the onboarding lunch and made new hires feel welcome" :sparkles:
zoe-peopleops: thanks @diego! saving for the award pool.
mel-hr: I'll confirm tax guidance by tomorrow. Also drafting recusal language for the panel.
raj-culture: Volunteers: Raj (kit design + labels), Zoe (form + comms), Ash (assembly lead), Nora (shipping coord).
dash-eng: I can do Mon/Tue assembly shifts.
zoe-peopleops: Budget rough: 15*$25 = $375 for e-gifts + $150 materials + $75 shipping = ~$600. Is that okay?
raj-culture: We have $700 in culture discretionary. Good to proceed.
mel-hr: Timeline suggestion: Nom window Mon 12/4 - Fri 12/8; assembly weekend 12/9; mail 12/11-12/13; announce winners at next all-hands 12/18.
zoe-peopleops: Action list: 1) create nom form (Zoe) 2) kit contents + vendor (Raj) 3) assemble team (Ash/Ash) 4) shipping list (Nora). Please reply with done.
dash-eng: I'll add assembly availability to the sheet.
zoe-peopleops: Link to draft sign-up: https://forms.gle/example - give feedback on copy if you see anything off.
mel-hr: Confirmed: gifts < $50 treated as de minimis per payroll but I'll send official note. Recusal rule included.
raj-culture: I'll get a 50-pack of hand warmers and some branded mugs quote today. If mugs push budget we drop to tea + hand warmer.
zoe-peopleops: If anyone wants to sponsor extra kits (team swag), ping me. Will post final comms after I get vendor quote.
nora-ops: Shipping heads up: for remote folks, ask for address opt-in by EOD Thu.
zoe-peopleops: Thanks team  will lock vendors once I have quotes. Winners will get both kit (if local) and an e-gift. Tagging @here for visibility.
